fact: The Danish National ID Centre's note of 2 November 2023 states that a birth or death is first entered in the handwritten family register of the kebabi office (approximately 2,000 kebabi), which issues a transfer or death letter to the sub-zoba office (54 sub-zobas), where the data is entered into the zoba's electronic database and the hard copies archived; there is no national population register, each zoba keeping its own electronic register updated by the sub-zoba administrations (citing the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs, 2017, and EASO, 2015).
title: Eritrea: Administrative structure and civil documents
